title: Lec 45 Recurrent Neural Networks(RNNs)
channel: NPTEL - Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru
description: Rigorous mathematical formulation of Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) for sequence modeling: data tensor topologies, failure modes of dense MLPs on variable-length sequences, latent state transitions ht = sigma(Whh ht-1 + Wxh xt + bh), computational graph unrolling, temporal parameter sharing, dynamical systems analogies, sequence classification vs seq2seq encoder-decoder topologies, unrolled RNNs as causal block-Toeplitz regularized MLPs, and auto-regressive generative modeling.

topics.title: Data Topologies & Sequence Modeling Prelude: Representing Temporal Observation Vectors
Supervised Sequence Tasks & The Variable Length Failure of Dense MLPs
The Recurrent Cell & Mathematical State Transition Equations
Computational Graph Unrolling & Parameter Sharing Across Time
Sequence Topologies: Sequence Classification vs Sequence-to-Sequence
Deep Stacked RNNs & RNNs as Structured Causal Block-Toeplitz MLPs
Probabilistic Auto-regressive Generation & Multi-Modal Vision-Language Pipelines
